title: The Twelve and Their Charge
summary: Jesus addresses the multitude, identifies the twelve who were called and given authority to baptize, and teaches blessings connected with believing and baptism.

explicit_facts.text: Twelve were called and received power and authority to baptize.
Jesus stretched forth his hand to the multitude and spoke to them.
Jesus taught that those who believe and are baptized may receive remission of sins and the Holy Ghost.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus addresses the assembled multitude while the twelve are present.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance, clothing, and arrangement of the multitude and the twelve.

spoken_dialogue.text: Blessed are ye if ye shall give heed
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Jesus's teachings about baptism and the Holy Ghost are stated as teachings, not depicted as a visible miracle.
prohibited_inventions: Depicting baptism, fire, or the Holy Ghost as occurring in this moment.

title: Blessings for the Poor in Spirit, Those Who Mourn, and the Meek
summary: A speaker declares blessings for the poor in spirit who come unto him, those who mourn, and the meek.

explicit_facts.text: The speaker says the kingdom of heaven belongs to the poor in spirit who come unto him.
The speaker says those who mourn shall be comforted.
The speaker says the meek shall inherit the earth.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The speaker may be depicted speaking.
unspecified_visual_details: The speaker’s appearance and the setting are not described.
No listeners are identified in the supplied verses.

spoken_dialogue.text: And again, blessed are all they that mourn, for they shall be comforted.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These are teachings; no particular act of mourning, comfort, or inheritance is narrated.
prohibited_inventions: Naming the speaker or listeners from context outside the supplied verses.
Depicting the promised blessings as events occurring in this scene.

title: Hunger, Mercy, and Purity
summary: Jesus teaches blessings for those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, the merciful, and the pure in heart.

explicit_facts.text: Those who hunger and thirst after righteousness shall be filled with the Holy Ghost.
The merciful shall obtain mercy.
The pure in heart shall see God.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus speaks to the assembled multitude.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance and reactions of Jesus and the listeners.

spoken_dialogue.text: And blessed are all the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The promise of seeing God is a teaching, not a narrated appearance of God.
prohibited_inventions: Depicting God appearing in this moment.

title: Peacemakers and the Persecuted
summary: Jesus teaches blessings for peacemakers and the persecuted, and tells his hearers to rejoice because of their reward in heaven.

explicit_facts.text: Peacemakers shall be called the children of God.
Those persecuted for Jesus's name's sake have the kingdom of heaven.
Jesus says his hearers are blessed when reviled and falsely accused for his sake, and tells them they will have great joy and a reward in heaven.
Jesus refers to prophets who were persecuted before them.

unspecified_visual_details: The identity or appearance of the earlier prophets and any persecutors.

spoken_dialogue.text: For ye shall have great joy and be exceedingly glad
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The earlier persecution is referenced, not shown as a present event.
prohibited_inventions: Depicting past prophets or persecutors as present.

title: Salt and Light

explicit_facts.text: Jesus calls his hearers the salt of the earth and teaches that salt losing its savor is good for nothing.
Jesus calls his hearers the light of the people and says a city on a hill cannot be hid.
Jesus describes a candle placed on a candlestick to give light to all in the house.

unspecified_visual_details: Whether a candle, candlestick, house, hill, or city is physically present.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Salt and light are figures of speech in the teaching, not narrated physical transformations.
prohibited_inventions: Showing the multitude transformed into salt or light, or inventing a city or candle as part of the setting.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says he came not to destroy the law or the prophets but to fulfill them.
